model: Original TOM_RTH only: last cash session of month and first3 cash sessions; long09:30open to15:59close. Main2024Dec30/31 remain non-ToM as in the original incomplete-month exclusion. No new filters or sizing.
benchmark: Same-clock long on ALL complete eligible sessions and on the complementary non-ToM sessions. Compare means per exposed day, not unequal-exposure cumulative profits. All-session benchmark includes ToM and is not an independent control.
volatility: Descriptive common sample with finite prior ATR14>0. Compare (gross_points-1.225)/prior_ATR14. Do not remove missing-ATR trades from the original model. No full-sample volatility thresholds or sizing rule.

inference.method: Moving block bootstrap of2 consecutive calendar MONTH clusters,10000 replications, fixed seeds20261022101/102. Resample whole months, use ratios of pooled event sums/counts; never equal-weight daily or event-rich month means. Percentile95% intervals. Approximate two-sided null-centered bootstrap p=(1+count(abs(diff*-diff)>=abs(diff)))/(B+1). Weak dependence/stationarity and few-month limitations, not exact randomization inference.
inference.tests: Exactly4 new exploratory contrasts: ToM minus non-ToM in raw net points and net points/priorATR for each of2 separate sources; Holm4. Other means, paths, delays, quarters and cost cases descriptive only. Previous25/125 families unchanged.
inference.decision: No formal promotion. Exploratory support only if all4 adjusted contrasts are positive and p<.05; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_NO_PROMOTION. This is an audit label, not a new preregistration or live authorization.

risk: minute-close marked equity drawdown with fullRT cost deducted at entry
worst day, MAE/MFE, top3 contribution and removal, leave-one-day/quarter-out; no post-hoc exclusions become trading filters

execution.exit: Same fixed15:59close proxy, no exit timing search
execution.warning: 1/2 extra ticks PER LEG on top of fixed baseline. No BBO/queue/latency evidence; exact open/close fills not certified.

source_check: Existing NQH24 pilot against generic on all complete common sessions2024Jan22-Feb16. Fixed old timestamp normalization only, no shift search. Same-date agreement is not sample independence.
restrictions: No unseen history, independent holdout, purchases, downloads, account changes, orders, Git push or external deployment.
public_output: Aggregates, quarters, sensitivity and report only. No raw OHLCV, daily/trade arrays, absolute source paths or protected-file manifest.
